title: Cancer hotspot mutations rewire ERK2 specificity by selective exclusion of docking interactions.
authors: Torres Robles, Jaylissa; Stiegler, Amy L; Boggon, Titus J; Turk, Benjamin E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究癌症热点突变如何通过选择性排除ERK2与无序区域短线性基序的对接互作来重编程底物特异性，涉及IDR介导的PPI机制建模，但方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟方法较弱。
abstract: The protein kinase ERK2 is recurrently mutated in human squamous cell carcinomas and other tumors. ERK2 mutations cluster in an essential docking recruitment site that interacts with short linear motifs found within intrinsically disordered regions of ERK substrates and regulators. Cancer-associated mutations do not disrupt ERK2 docking interactions altogether but selectively inhibit some interactions while sparing others. However, the full scope of disrupted or maintained interactions remains unknown, limiting our understanding of how these mutations contribute to cancer. We recently defined the docking interactome of wild-type ERK2 by screening a yeast two-hybrid library of proteomic short linear motifs. Here, we apply this approach to the two most recurrent cancer-associated mutants. We find that most sequences binding to WT ERK2 also interact with both mutant forms. Analysis of differentially interacting sequences revealed that ERK2 mutants selectively lose the ability to bind sequences conforming to a specific motif. We solved the co-crystal structure of ERK2 in complex with a peptide fragment of ISG20, a screening hit that binds exclusively to the WT kinase. This structure demonstrated the mechanism by which cancer hotspot mutations at Glu81, Arg135, Asp321, and Glu322 selectively impact peptide binding. Finally, we found that cancer-associated ERK2 mutations had decreased activity in phosphorylating GEF-H1/ARHGEF2, a known ERK substrate harboring a WT-selective docking motif. Collectively, our studies provide a structural rationale for how a broad set of interactions are disrupted by ERK2 hotspot mutations, suggesting mechanisms for pathway rewiring in cancers harboring these mutations.
abstract_zh: 蛋白激酶ERK2在人类鳞状细胞癌及其他肿瘤中频繁发生突变。ERK2突变聚集在一个关键的对接招募位点，该位点与ERK底物及调控因子内在无序区域中发现的短线性基序相互作用。癌症相关突变并未完全破坏ERK2的对接相互作用，而是选择性抑制某些相互作用，同时保留其他相互作用。然而，被破坏或维持的相互作用的完整范围仍属未知，这限制了我们对这些突变如何促进癌症的理解。我们近期通过筛选蛋白质组短线性基序的酵母双杂交文库，定义了野生型ERK2的对接相互作用组。在此，我们将该方法应用于两个最频繁复发的癌症相关突变体。我们发现，大多数与WT ERK2结合的序列也能与两种突变体形式相互作用。对差异相互作用序列的分析揭示，ERK2突变体选择性地丧失结合符合特定基序序列的能力。我们解析了ERK2与ISG20肽段片段（一个仅与WT激酶结合的筛选命中物）复合物的共晶结构。该结构阐明了癌症热点突变Glu81、Arg135、Asp321和Glu322选择性影响肽段结合的机制。最后，我们发现癌症相关ERK2突变在磷酸化GEF-H1/ARHGEF2（一个含有WT选择性对接基序的已知ERK底物）方面活性降低。总体而言，我们的研究为ERK2热点突变如何破坏广泛相互作用提供了结构基础，提示了携带这些突变的癌症中通路重连的机制。
